name: dsfd_capt_cd_split1016p-split1p-COMMIT
purpose: Native-capture successor of split1016n dsfd_capt_cd: pin-registered f_st (PINREG=1, +1 ckv on f_st->t_cd). Tile-local benches: capcd_eq vs the frozen 2314b2b4d form at +1 ckv alignment; NOTOG mutant must fail.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_capt_cd #(.PINREG(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl_c/dsfd_capt_cd.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_cd_split1016p/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_cd_split1016p/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_cd_split1016p --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_capt_cd  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Successor of CLOSED split1016n (dsfd_capt_cd_split1016n-split1n-deaed7cee, record 0c30c32f2, TT +319.07/FF +30.18) that still fails the native pin audit: f_st[2] capture 203.7 ps > 190 (launch 177.3, R 90.0, spread 9.2): the ICG ENA is captured on the un-inserted clock at the ICG, so no input->ENA path meets 190.  PINREG=1: every used f_st bit ([0],[2],[3],[13:4]) lands on a pin-register D pin; the ok_q/armed/ICG-gated t_cd bank runs on the registered copy.  Exactly the split1016n function with f_st delayed one ckv edge (capcd_eq with CAPCD_PINREG: reference fed f_st delayed 1 edge, every t_cd bit every edge).  COST: capture DONE toggle +1 ckv (f_st -> t_cd 1 -> 2 serial edges), reported to S-FUNC.  Pins and outline unchanged.

reroute_reason.fix: RTL pin flops: dsfd_capt_cd #(.PINREG(1)) registers every used f_st bit at the pin (fs_q, direct D), the ICG ENA and t_cd bank are fed from fs_q (no input reaches an ENA/mux select); +1 ckv on f_st->t_cd
